experiment_data.hypothesis: FewNERD N=16 with Qwen2.5-7B: extending N-scaling curve to N=16 for 7B model. At N=8 the 7B model shows diminishing oracle gains; N=16 tests whether the plateau continues or breaks, providing a critical data point for the N-scaling law F1(N)=a-b*N^(-c) at the 7B scale.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -u code/run_mvp_pilot.py --model_path checkpoints/qwen25-7b-fewnerd-merged --data_dir data/fewnerd/ --dataset fewnerd --n_samples 16 --temperature 1.0 --seed 42 --collect_logprobs --output_dir output/fewnerd_7b_n16_seed42/
